name: VHS Wobble
desc: Worn analog-tape pass: horizontal line jitter, a bright tracking band rolling through frame, chroma fringe at the edges, drifting grain and a live monospace timecode OSD in the corner, with thermal false-color and CCTV variants.

style.doc: tape=classic VHS color fringe + tracking / worn=yellowed heavily-degraded tape / thermal=false-color heat-ramp remap of the frame (abstract) / security=green-cast monochrome CCTV, REC dot / crt=clean color fringe, lighter wear

act.doc: play=steady with occasional tracking rolls, timecode counts up / rewind=fast upward roll, heavy jitter, timecode races / degrade=noise + dropouts creep up over ~100s then reset

label.doc: OSD tag text (uppercased, <=10 chars; overridden by security/thermal styles)
